vfx_enemy_skill_runner_dash.meaning: The speed wedge and its tip must point from the zombie toward the base.

vfx_enemy_skill_charge.meaning: The charge cone must point from the charger toward the base.

vfx_enemy_skill_leap_strike.meaning: The authored arc runs upper-left to lower-right and must be rotated so its landing point is below the zombie.

vfx_enemy_skill_phase_shift.meaning: The phase trail must follow the boss movement toward the base.

vfx_enemy_skill_ranged_spit.meaning: The venom launch wedge must point from the spitter toward its target.

boss_attacks.contract: cast origin, travel path when applicable, and base impact must form one continuous cause-and-effect chain

boss_skills.contract: the effect must stay attached to its source, destination, or declared area and must agree with mechanic movement

character_actives.contract: cast origin and affected battlefield region must be visible without covering critical HUD information

card_skill_casts.contract: pickup/cast feedback must be centered on the player and remain inside the viewport

hits.contract: impact core must overlap the damaged target

deaths.contract: death effect must originate at the defeated enemy and may not expose a rectangular source crop

enemy_poison_actions.contract: impact, directional launch, persistent ground area, and healing column must not collapse to the same silhouette

hard_edge_exceptions.vfx_boss_phase: An authored horizontal phase band; its long left/right boundary is the graphic's intended silhouette, not an atlas crop.
hard_edge_exceptions.vfx_levelup_glow: An authored vertical rank beam; its bottom boundary is intentionally grounded under the unit.
hard_edge_exceptions.vfx_target_lock: A wide targeting bracket whose long lateral edges are intentional UI geometry.
hard_edge_exceptions.vfx_threat_warning: A wide warning bracket whose long lateral edges are intentional UI geometry.

rules: No unexplained hard crop or rectangular alpha plate.
Directional tip, trail, actor movement, and destination agree.
Projectile launch point, flight path, and impact point are continuous.
Area effect center and visible radius agree with the gameplay target area.
Critical HUD bars and buttons remain readable during peak frames.
